description: Return a compact analytics summary for this workspace over the last `days` days (default 30): conversation counts + resolution rate, message volume + AI share, plus a live snapshot of today (UTC). `resolved`, `resolutionRatePct` and `avgResolutionHours` exclude conversations closed by auto-resolve; `autoResolved` counts those separately and `resolvedIncludingAuto` is the total including them.

days.description: Look-back window in days for the conversation/message stats (default 30).

name: get_analytics
title: Get Analytics
